title: Fasting glucose in the 60-person dinner-timing cohort
alt: A roughly symmetric histogram of 60 fasting glucose readings, tallest between 136 and 148 mg/dL, with one line marking the mean and median at 142 mg/dL.
longDescription: Sixty fasting glucose readings are grouped into seven bins 12 mg/dL wide, running from 100 to 184 mg/dL. The counts rise from 3 in the lowest bin to 18 in the 136-to-148 bin and fall away again to 3 in the highest bin, so the left and right sides of the picture look much alike. Because the shape is close to symmetric, the mean and the median land on the same value, 142 mg/dL, and a single marker carries both. The five-number summary of these readings is minimum 104, lower quartile 130, median 142, upper quartile 155, maximum 181 mg/dL, giving a range of 77 mg/dL and an interquartile range of 25 mg/dL. The standard deviation is 18 mg/dL. This is an illustrative teaching data set, not a record of real patients.
